name: layout-grid

frames.best_why: A photo is expanded in the centre with its Tokyo caption revealed while the grid dims behind.

tagline: Click any photo in the mosaic and it grows into the centre with its caption.
summary: A four-photo mosaic of travel images. Clicking one lifts it into the middle of the grid, dims the rest and slides a white title and caption up over the picture; clicking the dark area puts it back.
appearance: A four-photo mosaic on black: a wide close-up of hands fanning banknotes, a dark contour swirl, a plant against a tiled wall and a wide sea cliff. Cards sit close together with small gaps, and the whole grid dims when one is open.
behaviour: Clicking a photo lifts it into the centre of the grid, where it enlarges while a black veil fades behind it and its title and copy slide up from the bottom. Clicking the dark area returns it.
demo_content: Photos of banknotes, contour swirls, a plant and a sea cliff, labelled Tokyo, Santorini, Machu Picchu and Patagonia.
search_phrases: photo grid where a card expands on click
gallery that zooms a picture to center
image mosaic with click to enlarge
grid of photos that open in place
use_when: An image-led section where visitors should open a single photo without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Keyboard or screen-reader use: the tiles are clickable divs with no tab stop or roles.
customise: Pass a cards array of id, thumbnail, content and a className for the grid span; the expanded size, veil darkness and motion are fixed.
weight_why: Four large photos with shared layout animations on open and close.

a11y.note: Cards are clickable divs with no keyboard access or roles, and the alt text is just the word thumbnail.

issues: Tiles are divs, so the gallery cannot be opened by keyboard.
The expanded card stays only half width, so its caption sits tight over the photo.
Alt text is the generic word thumbnail on every image.
polish_why: Crisp photo mosaic and a smooth zoom to centre; div tiles exclude keyboard users.
title: Layout Grid
